description.p: A native GNOME front-end for openfortivpn with first-class SAML / SSO support. The GUI manages multiple VPN profiles, opens your default browser for SAML authentication via openfortivpn's built-in --saml-login flow, and shows live tunnel traffic in a libadwaita window.
The Flatpak build delegates the actual privileged openfortivpn invocation to the host system via flatpak-spawn, so the tunnel runs where it has to (root, /dev/net/tun) while the UI stays sandboxed.

ul.li: SAML / SSO login (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, …)
Multiple saved profiles with realm and trusted-cert support
System-tray status icon (when the AppIndicator GI is available)

description.p: Universal distro support: Alpine and Void packages, Gentoo ebuild hint, NixOS abort with Flatpak pointer, Flatpak manifest for cross-distro install. Sandbox-aware host_cmd() routes privileged calls through flatpak-spawn --host.
